name: pip-packages
description: Install pip packages with the Python interpreter already in the container (from the Python feature or a Python image), into its system site-packages rather than a venv or pipx. Also registers libpython with the dynamic linker when it cannot be found, so programs embedding Python (e.g. simulators loading cocotb) can load it.

packages.description: pip requirement specifiers, comma- or space-separated, e.g. 'cocotb==1.6.2,doit'. Empty installs nothing.
